canonical_api: canonical_plan(ir_or_events) -> list[dict]; canonical_tree(ir) -> dict or None

node.data: kind-specific evidence; no guessed original syntax

canonical_plan_policy: rename labels by ascending physical IL position
strip IDs and coordinate spans only
retain edge opcode, target order/aliasing and branch-to-next
retain EH boundary kind/type and ordering
condense only contiguous non-control instruction runs into leaf events; raw instruction arrays remain in leaves
never use this representation as the byte-equality oracle
completeness: emission_plan_complete means lossless event/instruction coverage only; tree_complete additionally requires region/template ownership without unresolved cases; complete requires both. Raw event coverage NEVER turns unknown structure complete.
identity: Caller binds the read-only method DTO to artifact SHA/MVID; original primary REA identity is in rea-artifact-identity.json. No mutation of methodDTO.

event_branch.role: mechanically derived CFG role; not part of comparison
event_branch.predicate: typed consumed stack values and exact branch relation; .un preserved

event_label.label: arbitrary string unique per emitted position or alias

event_leaf.leaf_id: link to raw IL ranges in leaves; source uses source_node

canonical_tree_policy: Flatten sequence wrappers and contiguous leaves only
Preserve condition opcodes, explicit joins, pre/post loop form and entry/tail branches
Preserve transfer target_role and lexical loop depth
Only fixture-proved syntactic emission equivalence classes may share a structural representation; no assembly normalization
